(program (kernel-declaration (%kernel.2 () (Kernel)))
  (public-ledger-declaration
    ((%results.1 (0) (Set (tbytes 32)))))
  (native
    %persistentCommit.3
    ((%value.4 (tboolean)) (%rand.5 (tbytes 32)))
    (tbytes 32))
  (witness %score.6 () (tunsigned 65535))
  (witness %resultSalt.7 () (tbytes 32))
  (circuit %grade.0 () (ttuple) (= #t %s.8 (call %score.6))
    (= #t %t.11 (< 16 %s.8 50))
    (= #t %t.12 (select %t.11 #t #f))
    (= #t %t.13 (select %t.11 #f #t))
    (= #t %t.14 (select %t.11 #f #t))
    (= #t %t.15 (select %t.14 #t #f))
    (= #t %t.16 (select %t.14 #f #t))
    (= %t.15 %t.17 (call %resultSalt.7))
    (= %t.15 %tmp.9 (call %persistentCommit.3 #t %t.17))
    (= %t.15 %t.18 (public-ledger %results.1 (0) insert %tmp.9))
    (= %t.16 %t.19 (call %resultSalt.7))
    (= %t.16 %tmp.10 (call %persistentCommit.3 #f %t.19))
    (= %t.16
       %t.20
       (public-ledger %results.1 (0) insert %tmp.10))
    (= #t %t.21 (tuple)) %t.21))
